text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager SEV-2 for private cluster 'gamma-corp' — sustained GPU queue growth and autoscaler failing to create nodes. See: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1900001111
Alyssa (oncall): taking. What's the current backlog and error signal?
Priya (eng-sre): backlog ~ 620 requests, growth +95/min over last 8m. Customer-facing 502/503 spike observed on inference endpoints. Routing shows many throttles from the rate limiter.
Sam (prod): service graph shows high queue depth on the gpu-router and repeated scale-up attempts logged.
Diego (infra): autoscaler logs show create-instance errors and then image pull failures inside the VPC. Snippet: 
```
autoscaler: 2026-08-07T09:21:43Z ERROR create instance failed: quota_exceeded: cannot allocate nvidia-a100
bootstrap: 2026-08-07T09:22:10Z WARN image pull backoff: registry rate limit exceeded
```
Nora (cust-success): customer noticed errors around 09:20UTC and escalated to support. They are worried about SLA. On a call with them now.
Alyssa (oncall): short fixes: 1) enable tenant-level concurrency cap to 150, 2) shift new requests to CPU fallbacks where possible, 3) escalate cloud quota + registry ops. Implementing cap now. Command: 
```
POST /internal/throttle {"tenant":"gamma-corp","concurrency":150}
```
ops-bot: Throttle set: tenant=gamma-corp concurrency=150 (actor=Alyssa).
Priya (eng-sre): deploying routing rule to prefer hosted-small-quant variant for non-streaming workloads. Patch applied, waiting for rollout.
Sam (prod): rolling update started. We should expect slightly lower model fidelity but much lower GPU pressure.
Diego (infra): cloud provider responded: quota for a100 region is at hard limit; provisioning requests are queued. Also seeing failed init hooks due to expired CA in the node bootstrap image causing kubelet TLS errors: 
```
kubelet: ERROR tls handshake: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid
```
Priya (eng-sre): that would explain nodes stuck in NotReady. Any chance of swapping to pre-warmed AMIs/images in the VPC to bypass registry pulls?
Diego (infra): starting a manual seed image upload to the VPC registry and kicking off instances using that image. Also requesting quota bump with priority.
Alyssa (oncall): can we bring up CPU worker pool now for embeddings only? Command to scale: 
```
kubectl scale deploy/emb-cpu-gamma --replicas=6 -n clusters/gamma
```
Priya (eng-sre): CPU workers live, routing about 22% of embedding requests to CPU. Error rate dropped from ~11% to ~3.5% over 12 minutes.
Diego (infra): uploaded prebuilt node image and launched 4 instances with manual bootstrap. Two became Ready, two failing with container runtime errors referencing missing CA cert. Pushing fixed bootstrap config to image builder to include updated CA bundle.
Nora (cust-success): customer asked for ETA. I told them we're deploying fallbacks and expect error rates to be low within 20-30 minutes, but we're escalating quota/registry.
Priya (eng-sre): autoscaler limits: current maxNodes=10; traffic indicates we may need up to 18. Suggest a temporary bump if quota allows.
Alyssa (oncall): patching autoscaler maxNodes=18 now (will revert post-incident). 
```
kubectl apply -f clusters/gamma/autoscaler-patch.yaml
```
ops-bot: Applied autoscaler patch (maxNodes=18) by Alyssa.
Diego (infra): provider approved expedited quota request for +8 GPUs; new quota in ~45-90m. Meanwhile manual nodes give partial relief. Registry ops found a bug in token refresh for VPC pulls causing 429s; they rolled a fix and caches are primed.
Priya (eng-sre): after manual nodes + cpu fallbacks + routing change, backlog dropped 620 -> 145 in 20m. 503s dropped to 1.2%.
Alyssa (oncall): good progress. Keep throttles and fallback in place until stable for 30m. Prepare handoff to Ryan in 20m unless resolved sooner.
Sam (prod): logging note: capture pre- and post-incident request traces for the customer's SLA report.
Nora (cust-success): customer wants an incident log and assurance that images won't break bootstrapping again. Asking for a timeline for registry caching and pre-warmed images.
Alyssa (oncall): follow-ups for postmortem: 1) ensure bootstrap image CA validation tests in CI, 2) region quota monitoring and proactive pre-requests for enterprise clusters, 3) VPC registry caching and token refresh robustness, 4) autoscaler guardrails for min/maxNodes vs projected demand. Assigning owners in incident ticket.
ops-bot: :thumbsup: 2 reactions.
ryan (oncall-next): standing by for handoff at 09:45UTC if still in monitoring.
incident-bot: Incident moved to MONITORING. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1900001111
Alyssa (oncall): final live note: queue trending stable, keeping the cap and CPU fallback until we see sustained <5% errors for 30m. I'll assemble timeline and then hand off.
